# SIMP

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_residual()`](https://gcol33.github.io/SIMP/reference/add_residual.md)
  : Add residual component to close composition
- [`as.array(`*`<simp_fit>`*`)`](https://gcol33.github.io/SIMP/reference/as.array.simp_fit.md)
  : Extract draws as array
- [`as.data.frame(`*`<simp_fit>`*`)`](https://gcol33.github.io/SIMP/reference/as.data.frame.simp_fit.md)
  : Extract posterior draws

  : Collapse components according to a mapping

  : Collapse vegetation layers

  : Collapse rare components into "other"
- [`components()`](https://gcol33.github.io/SIMP/reference/components.md)
  : Get component names
- [`count_zeros()`](https://gcol33.github.io/SIMP/reference/count_zeros.md)
  : Count zeros in compositional data
- [`default_priors()`](https://gcol33.github.io/SIMP/reference/default_priors.md)
  : Get default priors for a model family
- [`extract_random_effects()`](https://gcol33.github.io/SIMP/reference/extract_random_effects.md)
  : Extract random effect terms from formula

  : Stick-breaking family for ordered compositional data

  Get species names

  Specify a varying effect
